featured.title: Midday Vibes
featured.shortDescription: The vibrant heartbeat of Lagos daytime radio. Packed with heavy music rotations, hilarious audio bytes, trending comedy, and live listener shoutouts.
featured.fullDescription: Midday Vibes brings the authentic sounds and street rhythms of Lagos straight to your airwaves. Hosted by Simi Ogunleye, enjoy heavy Afrobeats rotations, infectious comedy segments, trending audio soundbites, and live interactions across every area in Lagos.
